intro.title: What I do
intro.content: I'm Morteza Karimi, a Team Lead and Senior Software Engineer based in Tehran. I specialize in migrating legacy workflows to modern JavaScript stacks and building ERP platforms that teams can trust every day.

experience.title: How I work
experience.content: I lead with clarity and code quality. Whether I'm architecting a NestJS backend, shipping a Next.js frontend, or mentoring developers, I focus on measurable outcomes — fewer manual steps, faster releases, and systems that stay maintainable as they grow.

opensource.title: Open source
opensource.content: I contribute to the developer community through open-source projects on GitHub. Sharing reusable tools and lessons learned is part of how I grow — and how I help other engineers move faster.

interests.title: Beyond the screen
interests.content: Outside of engineering, I enjoy reading, exploring new ideas, and spending time with my three cats. Curiosity away from the keyboard keeps my problem-solving sharp when I'm back at it.

connect.title: Let's talk
connect.content: I'm open to team lead and senior engineering roles, consulting, and collaborations on ambitious products. Send an email or connect on LinkedIn — I'd like to hear what you're building.
